dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral plane with sharp high-contrast perimeters. The most prominent structures exhibit irregular, non-circular exterior geometries with a steep gradient transition from light-intensity outer rings to dark-intensity internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the anterior-dorsal (neck/shoulder) region. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack the internal gradient found in the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal-mid annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary linear configuration of four smaller high-intensity blobs is visible along the mid-lateral flank.
